reuse.cutover: existing workspace cutover record/guard only; no second state machine

rows.rule: At most one writable canonical binding per resource+data role (W4)
cwd / memory / continuity / artifact are separately authorized roles of one resourceId
rows.phase1b: handles expose role roots; never infer from path

rows.rule: P0 stays WorkspaceBindingRecord; storageKind is appendix A only
rows.phase1b: must not mix into P0 cutover

rows.rule: objectKey is a locator fragment, never a resourceId
rows.phase1b: export/import preserve resourceId, rewrite locators only

rows.rule: Extend existing workspace cutover record/guard; receipt stores resourceId + bindingId + contentVersion
Lifecycle stays on DataGovernanceEnvelope; deletion marker is not a second identity
rows.phase1b: retired binding cannot be resurrected without new receipt

rows.rule: Memory Asset forget/purge is Memory governance; workspace binding retirement is cutover
rows.phase1b: no shared resourceId between Memory Asset and Workspace

rows.rule: Cache key = tenantId + resourceId + governanceVersion + operation; never path or agentId
rows.phase1b: invalidate on catalog revision / binding flip

rows.rule: Export identity is resourceId; import remaps locators, never mints a second resourceId for the same Envelope
Rollback flips binding + restores sqlite snapshot; resourceId unchanged (W12)
Old processes without the new binding must fail closed after fencing; no silent path fallback

offlineBootstrap.unknownConflict: stay in disposition list; never enter normal Catalog
